title: THE BACKPACK CUE FOLLOWS KEY CHANGES
why: His order of 2026-10-09: a raid line names the key the action is really on. The cue under the gun card always said B / I BACKPACK, even after CHANGE KEYS moved the backpack to another key. It now names the keys as set; unmoved keys read B / I as before, and the controller cue is unchanged.
now: The backpack cue under the gun card names the keys as set in CHANGE KEYS.

edits.anchor: ctx.fillText(padOn()?padB('VIEW  BACKPACK'):'B / I  BACKPACK',W-16,by-LH(70));   // v13.52: pad B is the dodge roll
